suitability.reason: The desk is isolated, fills the frame, has a strong front-right three-quarter silhouette, exposes all visible material families, and includes dedicated knob and tabletop-corner close-ups. Hidden rear and drawer-interior surfaces can be conservatively inferred from furniture symmetry.

details.description: Large rounded-rectangle plan radius at the tabletop corners; this radius is independent of the thin slab height.
details.scale: meso; radius about 0.045 of total desk width
details.affects: tabletop silhouette and corner highlight flow

details.description: Broad soft perimeter roll from the top plane into the darker vertical edge band.
details.scale: meso; radius about 0.018 of desk width with four geometric segments
details.affects: tabletop perimeter geometry and grazing-light response

details.description: Long irregular walnut strands run along the desk width across the top face.
details.affects: top albedo, roughness, and tangent-space normal

details.description: The tabletop vertical edge band is darker and higher contrast than the broad top plane.
Narrow recessed dark reveal separates the top slab from the front rail.
One wide center drawer is flanked by two narrower drawers in an approximately 1.0:2.15:1.0 front-width rhythm.
details.affects: drawer assembly proportions and front silhouette

details.description: All three drawer fronts are shallow rounded rectangles with softly raised perimeter highlights.
details.scale: meso; corner radius about 0.14 of drawer height

details.description: Thin recessed gaps outline each drawer face and cast soft cavity shadows.
details.scale: micro; gap about 0.01 of drawer height

details.description: Horizontal grain follows each drawer's long axis with a separate phase on each front.
details.scale: micro directional strands plus meso tonal bands
details.affects: drawer albedo, normal, and roughness orientation

details.description: Three centered aged-brass knobs use a short neck and a thick domed circular crown.
details.scale: micro repeated assembly; crown about 0.27 of drawer height
details.affects: knob geometry, centered spacing, and attachment depth

details.description: Compact warm highlight appears on the upper-left knob crown while the rim stays darker.
Brown-gold tarnish mottling concentrates near the knob rim and lower crown.
details.scale: micro irregular crown mask with rim bias
details.affects: brass albedo, roughness, and cavity response

details.description: Legs are broad below the apron and taper downward to smaller feet; the taper direction is unambiguous in both front legs.
details.scale: macro; foot cross-section about 0.62 of upper leg
details.affects: leg silhouette, stance, and under-desk negative space

details.description: Restrained soft leg corners preserve a square furniture cross-section and transition into rounded feet.
details.scale: meso; edge radius about 0.1 of upper-leg width
details.affects: leg edge highlights and foot termination

details.description: Leg and stile grain runs vertically, perpendicular to tabletop and drawer grain.
details.affects: frame albedo, normal direction, and roughness breakup

details.description: Localized dark cavity response appears under the top, around drawer recesses, and at apron-leg joins.
details.scale: meso contact masks with micro crevice bias
details.affects: frame AO, depth separation, and joint grounding
